analyzed_vuln.description: In the named-color profile branch, _cmsReadDevicelinkLUT reads cmsSigNamedColor2Tag via cmsReadTag(), getting a pointer owned by the profile tag cache. On pipeline construction failure, its Error path calls cmsFreeNamedColorList(nc), incorrectly freeing that profile-owned object. Later, cmsCloseProfile() frees tags again via Type_NamedColor_Free -> cmsFreeNamedColorList, causing a double-free/use-after-free (ASan read in cmsFreeNamedColorList). Root cause is invalid ownership handling and manual free of cached tag data.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a profile parsed as cmsSigNamedColorClass with a readable NamedColor2 tag so nc is allocated/cached, and then a failure in _cmsReadDevicelinkLUT after nc is obtained (e.g., failure in cmsPipelineAlloc or cmsPipelineInsertStage/_cmsStageAllocNamedColor path during transform creation from the fuzzer input). The first free happens in _cmsReadDevicelinkLUT Error path; second free occurs when run_test closes the profile (cmsCloseProfile), leading to UAF/double free.
